name: Inline shell command in a skill or command file
description: A skill or command markdown body embeds a !`cmd` placeholder or a ```! fenced block. Claude Code runs these as PREPROCESSING before the content reaches the model: no model decision, no permission prompt. Emission is decided by the adapter's scanner (a literal KEY=!`cmd` never becomes an entity, per the official inline-form rule), so this rule only surfaces what was already emitted.
message: Inline shell command runs on invocation, before the skill or command content reaches the model
